title: pytest: adjust threshold in test_20_11_crazy_pings to better pass on arm64 (cont. 2)
body:
To mitigate flaky test failures even further, as seen in CI.

```
E       AssertionError: bad memory increase
E       assert (10.171875 * 1.25) > 12.78125

../../tests/http/test_20_websockets.py:330: AssertionError
```
Ref: https://github.com/curl/curl/actions/runs/39605314251/job/119240169258#step:32:2152

Follow-up to 893d3066f49c83680bcaac95206e7edb81a589c0 #23468 Follow-up to ffc18980959ab97aece40c9435cf57f87dca940b #23298

Closes #23468

files.patch:
@@ -327,7 +327,7 @@ def srv():
         assert r.exit_code in [55, 56], f'{r.dump_logs()}'  # SEND/RECV_ERROR
         assert r.profile, f'{r}'
         rss2 = r.profile.stats['rss-max'] / (1024 * 1024)
-        assert (rss1 * 1.25) > rss2, 'bad memory increase'
+        assert (rss1 * 1.35) > rss2, 'bad memory increase'
 
     # test small frames delivery when pausing
     def test_20_12_pause_frames_small(self, env: Env, ws_4frames):
